Weaknesses: a few overstated or loosely supported claims, and the cited-claim list is not well aligned with the narrative.","problems":["Claims the excess 99215 'appears in every complexity stratum', but the 4-condition stratum (13.3% vs 11.9% overall share) is barely above the all-provider share, so this is overstated.","The first listed example claim (C0007269, a 99214 with low MDM) is not tied to a low-complexity 99215 point, and the cited examples are mostly the first rows rather than the most telling ones; the low back pain and URI claims discussed in the text (C0006824, C0007205) are not in cited_claim_ids.","The 'heavy 99214 share points the same way' inference is weak: the 99214 examples cited (C0006548, C0006904) are two cases, and no peer 99214 baseline is given.","The 0 vs 0% documented-below-billed comparison rests on a single documented 99215, so it carries almost no information; the summary acknowledges this but still states it as a finding.","The 'plain z-score 1.22' versus risk-adjusted 7.2 gap is flagged but not explained, which leaves the investigator unsure how strong the signal is.","The 'follow-up visits' characterization of Z09 claims is an interpretation not directly supported by the card."]}
